user.title: Apple WeatherKit
user.description: Paste the WeatherKit key from your Apple Developer account (Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles). The key is checked with Apple before it is saved and never leaves Home Assistant.

data_description.key_id: The 10-character ID shown next to the key.
data_description.team_id: The 10-character team ID in your membership details.
data_description.service_id: The Services ID registered under Identifiers, for example com.sfenton.home.weatherkit.
data_description.key_pem: Open the downloaded .p8 file and paste everything, including the BEGIN and END lines.

reauth_confirm.title: Apple rejected the WeatherKit key
reauth_confirm.description: The saved key no longer works. It may have been revoked, or WeatherKit was turned off for it. Paste a working key.

error.invalid_key: That isn't a WeatherKit private key. Paste the whole .p8 file.
error.invalid_auth: Apple rejected the key. Check that WeatherKit is ticked for this key and that the Key ID, Team ID and Services ID match it.
error.over_quota: This developer account has used its WeatherKit calls for the month.
error.no_data: Apple has no weather data for this location.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Apple's WeatherKit service. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This location is already set up.

data.forecast_interval_minutes: Refresh hourly and daily forecasts every

data_description.interval_seconds: Each update is one call. Once a minute uses about 45,000 calls a month.
data_description.forecast_interval_minutes: Forecasts ride along in an update, so this costs no extra calls.
data_description.monthly_budget: Updates slow down by themselves so the month stays under this. Apple includes 500,000.
data_description.air_quality: WeatherKit has no air quality data. This adds a free US AQI sensor.
